items.title: Dozens arrested as violence mars Sydney rally against Herzog visit
items.description: Thousands of people attend protests across the country against Israeli President Isaac Herzog's visit to Australia in the wake of the Bondi terror attack, with demonstrators in Sydney sprayed with pepper spray and led away in handcuffs.

items.title: Former ASIO spy reveals Bondi killer spent time with IS terror cell
items.description: The former undercover agent spied on the Akrams when he infiltrated a Sydney IS terror cell for Australia's intelligence agency.

items.title: Scottish Labour leader calls for Starmer to resign
items.description: Keir Starmer is facing calls to resign after damaging revelations about the man he picked to represent the UK in Washington.

items.title: The 'insane' reality of raising a nine-year-old in Trump and ICE's Minnesota
items.description: What was once a hindrance is now "a paranoia like I've never known before", one Minnesotan man says, as his family hides from immigration agents.

items.title: Prince William and Kate say they are 'deeply concerned' about Epstein files
items.description: The Prince and Princess of Wales say their thoughts remain focused on the victims of the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, in their first statement on the issue.

items.title: Another Optus tech 'issue' affects hundreds of thousands of customers
items.description: Optus says an issue is affecting mobile services for some customers, who are seeing "no service" or "SOS" on their device.

items.title: Live: Mathilde Gremaud claims gold over Eileen Gu
items.description: Holly Harris and Jason Chan will become the first Aussies in 12 years to represent the country in ice dancing, while Tess Coady and Meila Stalker will compete in the big air final. Follow live.

items.title: Families of methanol poisoning victims condemn investigation 'silence'
items.description: The families of Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles say they have been left in the dark following the 2024 poisoning deaths of their daughters.

items.title: Japan's new PM has signalled a security shift that could impact Australia
items.description: A stomping victory by the ruling coalition government of Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has opened the way for a major geo-strategic realignment in the Asia-Pacific region, with big implications for Australia.

items.title: Bad Bunny's Super Bowl half-time show features surprise guests
items.description: Global superstar Bad Bunny performs at the Super Bowl LX, sharing the stage with surprise guests Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin, while a couple weds on stage.

items.title: Luxury cruise ship being investigated after claims of 'horrifying' conditions
items.description: The maritime union says crew members of a luxury Carnival cruise ship allege they are being made to sleep in crowded rooms, lack access to safe free drinking water, and that some are earning as little as $2.50 an hour.

items.title: 'Massive' foreign-owned barge washes up on a tiny island in the Torres Strait
items.description: The barge drifted into Australian waters from Indonesia after breaking from its moorings during bad weather.

items.title: WA's north braces for impact as Tropical Cyclone Mitchell remains offshore
items.description: Tropical Cyclone Mitchell is yet to make landfall along the Gascoyne coast, but it has already brought wild weather to the region.

items.title: Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai sentenced to 20 years' jail in landmark case
items.description: Jimmy Lai, one of Hong Kong's most outspoken critics of China, has learned his fate after being sentenced this morning.

items.title: What the Epstein files tell us about Ghislaine Maxwell
items.description: This week, Ghislaine Maxwell could be a very unwelcome distraction for Donald Trump as she appears before one of America's top political institutions.

items.title: Commonwealth files defence against Linda Reynolds legal action
items.description: The Commonwealth files its defence against former senator Linda Reynolds, who is suing the government and its lawyers over a $2.4 million payout it made to Brittany Higgins.

items.title: Five of our most popular easy vegetarian meals
items.description: Looking to add some more vegetarian dishes to your weekly rotation? We have you covered with these five recipes that are perfect for meat-free Mondays.

items.title: Liberals despair at prospect of 'non-existence' and weigh leadership change
items.description: Sussan Ley could face a challenge to her leadership from Angus Taylor this week after a disastrous opinion poll showed the Coalition parties falling further behind One Nation.

items.title: Croc wrangler Matt Wright fined for landing chopper in backyard
items.description: The Netflix star, who is currently behind bars on unrelated charges, pleaded guilty to a single count for landing his chopper and taking off in the backyard of his former home in Darwin's rural area.

items.title: Christchurch terrorist in fiery exchanges in NZ Court of Appeal
items.description: The convicted Christchurch terrorist and murderer is giving testimony in the New Zealand Court of Appeal as he seeks to vacate his guilty pleas over his 2019 attack on two mosques.

items.title: Alleged murderer asks to be 'locked up' before women stabbed, court hears
items.description: Fifteen days before he allegedly killed a woman and attempted to kill another, Shaun Michael Dunk asked to be taken into custody so he would not be a danger to anyone.

items.title: Newcastle man receives payout over wrongful home invasion murder prosecution
items.description: A Newcastle man will receive a confidential payout from the NSW government for wrongful prosecution by police for an alleged home invasion murder.

items.title: Jon Kudelka, cartoonist and 'national treasure', dies aged 53
items.description: Award-winning Tasmanian cartoonist Jon Kudelka has died after being diagnosed with brain cancer in 2024.

items.title: Daly River set to surpass major flood level before peaking Tuesday
items.description: Flooding at the Daly River community is expected to surpass the major flood level late Monday, with a peak of 14.1 metres expected by Tuesday afternoon.

items.title: Court hears father showed no concern for children after fatal house fire
items.description: An inquest has started probing a fatal house fire, with a coroner tasked with trying to determine what sparked it and whether either parent may have been involved.
